:py:mod:`futuram.classes`
=========================

.. py:module:: futuram.classes

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   This subpackage contains the classes used by the futuram package.

   Modules:

   - processes.py: Contains the Process class and the subclasses of Process.

   - model.py: Contains the Model class.

   - matter.py: Contains the Element, Compound, Material, Component, Product and Matter classes.


   :noindex:
